subject.title: feat(memory): graduate sessionMemory from experimental — solve the multi-session continuity problem

question: Should `sessionMemory` graduate from experimental/default-off now, and should any stable version become default-on for new installs before the open visibility, duplicate-indexing, QMD export, ranking, privacy, and cost criteria are closed?
rationale: The implementation exists, but changing stability/default behavior affects transcript privacy, cross-channel visibility, QMD export, embedding cost, upgrade expectations, and source precedence; automation cannot choose that product/security policy safely.

options.title: Layered Stable Opt-In First
options.body: Keep session transcript memory opt-in while maintainers close the concrete source-label, visibility, duplicate-indexing, QMD, ranking, privacy, and cost-documentation criteria, then revisit default-on separately.

options.title: Default-On After Explicit Policy
options.body: Sponsor a broader product change that makes session transcript memory default-on only after DM/group scope, QMD export, visibility, opt-out, upgrade behavior, and live multi-channel proof are documented and tested.

options.title: Do Not Graduate Yet
options.body: Leave the experimental flag and current docs in place until user demand and live evidence justify revisiting the feature contract.

recommendation.title: Layered Stable Opt-In First
recommendation.body: Keep session transcript memory opt-in while maintainers close the concrete source-label, visibility, duplicate-indexing, QMD, ranking, privacy, and cost-documentation criteria, then revisit default-on separately.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the experimental session memory source and is the strongest history-backed owner for whether that feature becomes stable/default behavior.
